Chapter 969  Chapter 25 The Light Boat Has Crossed Thousands of Mountains (Please Subscribe)_2

Lin Yuan thought to himself.

Normally, a Second Layer Path Splitting Realm powerhouse would have an internal universe ultimately ranging between tens of thousands to a hundred thousand light-years, but Lin Yuan could reach a span of eighty million light-years.

"The internal universe of a Dao Realm, it's not much different."

Lin Yuan was in high spirits; an internal universe spanning eighty million light-years was considered vast and boundless even among those in the Dao Realm.

And within this universe? It is estimated that even if you combine all the ultimate internal universes of the Second Layer, they wouldn't fill one ten-thousandth of Lin Yuan's internal universe.

"With my current realm... Relying on the comprehension of many rules, I've just entered the Path Splitting Realm and have already reached the peak of the Path Splitting Realm."

Lin Yuan scrutinized himself.

Of course, this is about the realm.

As for battle strength?

Whether it's physical body and soul, or the internal world, or the comprehension of rules, Lin Yuan far surpasses the normal Path Splitting Realm.

Even if his life level has not reached the Dao Realm, Lin Yuan's actual combat power is not weaker than any Dao Realm.

Peaking the Path Splitting Realm while comparable to the Dao Realm is exceedingly rare in the vast Chaos Void. This is usually exclusive to the descendants of Great Saints or those wondrous beings with a thin lineage of time.

Moreover, Lin Yuan has just entered the Path Splitting Realm; the next few hundred to thousand years will be a period of rapid strength advancement, so much so that rivaling the peak of the Dao Realm is conceivable.

"My combat power... has been suppressed." Lin Yuan's gaze turned toward the cosmic starry skies.

At this moment, his combat power, comparable to the Dao Realm, is subtly suppressed by this universe, only allowing him to exert the peak level of the Path Splitting Realm.

Lin Yuan was not surprised by this; the multitude of information recorded in the Profound Xuanhuang lineage foresaw such circumstances.

The Chaos Void breeds countless universes, which in turn nurture countless lives, with the ultimate battle strength within these universes being the peak of the Path Splitting Realm.

Why is the peak of the Path Splitting Realm the ultimate strength within a universe? It is indeed hard to step into the Dao Realm during a cosmic era, but amidst countless universes and the passage of countless cosmic eras, wouldn't there be an anomaly?

Even if normal beings cannot achieve this, what about those Chaos Great Saints reincarnated? If they were to revive some of their memories, couldn't they step into the Dao Realm within a single cosmic era?

The fact remains that the universe itself suppresses everything that exceeds the peak of the Path Splitting Realm, which is the level of the Dao Realm.

This is a limitation of the larger environment, which even the reincarnated Chaos Great Saints have to follow. If they want to exert the power of the Dao Realm or even the Chaos Realm, the only way is to venture into the Chaos Void.

Of course, this limitation can be broken, which is by possessing the combat power of a Chaos Great Saint inside the universe.

This kind of power can shatter everything within a universe, causing a universe to enter destruction prematurely, surpassing the pressure limits of the universe.

But this is exceedingly difficult, even for those Chaos Great Saints. To recover to the level of a Great Saint's combat power within a cosmic era is not an easy task.

A Chaos Great Saint's combat power is not only about comprehending the rules, but also about the support of a strong body and soul.

To achieve this degree, one would need what can be called a vast amount of resources; draining entire continents of Chaos wouldn't suffice.

"Peak Path Splitting Realm combat power... that's enough." After pondering for a moment, Lin Yuan nodded slightly.

With his talent and methods, even with only the peak of the Path Splitting Realm combat power, he could easily suppress all ultimate Second Layer beings in this universe.

If those ultimate Second Layer beings dare to fight with Lin Yuan, the only outcome would be their complete demise.

...

"Hmm? My gourd?"

Lin Yuan seemed to recall something, raised his right hand, and reached into the depths of space and time.

When he retrieved it, a mysterious gourd the size of a palm appeared in Lin Yuan's hand.

This mysterious gourd was a war trophy Lin Yuan obtained when entering the Milky Way Star Region, the effects were extremely heaven-defying, capable of breaking the limits of an internal world.

Additionally, it has the effect of breaking the limit shackles on the physical body.

Even to this day, Lin Yuan has yet to hear of such abilities; there are countless treasures and opportunities in the Chaos Void with similar effects.

But they are all exceedingly rare, something that even the Chaos Venerables and Chaos Great Saints find hard to come by. But a mysterious gourd?

The liquid inside seems to be inexhaustible—at least Lin Yuan has not found any signs of depletion so far.

After Lin Yuan completely absorbed the seven-colored liquids inside the mysterious gourd, he discovered that the next step required his internal world to transform into an internal universe.

That is to say, to enter the Second Layer.

...

Before the assault on the ultimate, Lin Yuan was prepared for the worst.

That is, a failure that results in his complete demise, beyond even the rescue of the Myriad Realms Gate.

That's why he didn't carry the mysterious gourd on his person but left it in the depths of time and space.

With Lin Yuan's mastery over time and space, the ultimate Second Layer beings within this universe cannot possibly find the location of the mysterious gourd.

Thousands of years later, as long as Lin Yuan does not retrieve the gourd, the space-time constraints locking it will loosen, and the gourd will drift toward the Central Star Field of Human Civilization carrying the information left by Lin Yuan.

In Lin Yuan's plan, should he truly fall in death, the mysterious gourd left to human civilization would still be able to exert its value.

Now it seems.

Everything is going smoothly.

Lin Yuan looked at the gourd in his hand, and as he touched it with his skin, the gourd seemed to sense something, and its originally gray-purple color began to fade away.

"Is this transforming and nurturing?"

Lin Yuan guessed in his mind and immediately put the mysterious gourd inside his inner cosmic body.

Given the speed at which the gray-purple color was fading, this transformation and nurturing process would not end in a short time.

...

Across all corners of the universe.

The ultimate beings of the Twelfth Layer were nervously watching Lin Yuan's attempt to reach the ultimate level.

Whether Lin Yuan steps into the Twelfth Layer or not is of significant consequence to the future situation of this universe, and no Twelfth Layer powerhouses dare ignore it.

Especially for the Insect Race, Tianyu Clan, and other Twelfth Layer ultimates, who have always been mortal enemies of human civilization, with an irreconcilable hatred between them.

Once Lin Yuan truly enters the Twelfth Layer, they and their respective clans would no doubt face difficult times ahead and might spend the long years to come hiding within their Clan Suppression Weapons, barely clinging to survival.

"Galaxy Master, you must fail."

"Yes, you must not step into the Twelfth Layer."

Each of the Twelfth Layer ultimates were yearning in their hearts.

The next moment.

The aura of the Galaxy Master appeared again within the universe, and at the same time, the many Twelfth Layer ultimates also felt the karma of the Galaxy Master.

For a time, all the Twelfth Layer ultimates fell silent.

The reappearance of the aura and karma of the Galaxy Master implied that his attempt to reach the ultimate level was successful, and he smoothly stepped into the Twelfth Layer.

If the attempt had failed, his life essence and everything else would have disintegrated into nothingness, leaving no trace of aura or karma to re-emerge.

"Twelfth Layer."

"The Galaxy Master has stepped into the Twelfth Layer."

"It's over, the Galaxy Master at Eleventh Layer could already suppress those of the Twelfth Layer, and now that he is in the Twelfth Layer, his life essence has leapt forward, his inner world has expanded massively, and the power of the Galaxy Master will far surpass what it was before."

"Who can contend with the Galaxy Master?"

"I must contact human civilization and seek peace with the Galaxy Master."

...

The myriad Twelfth Layer ultimates each had their own thoughts, but without a doubt, in the long years to come, until the great collapse of the universe, the future direction of this universe would depend on the Galaxy Master.

Even the mighty Twelfth Layer ultimates must look to the Galaxy Master for their next breath.

...

"It's about time."

Lin Yuan, feeling a slight change in himself, stood up and stepped in a specific direction.

The nine supreme beings of human civilization had been safeguarding his path as he strove for the ultimate level; now that he successfully stepped into the Twelfth Layer, he naturally had to meet them first.

Amongst the starry skies.

The Xuanyuan Supreme and the other eight supreme beings of human civilization were also immersed in joy.

They naturally felt the karma of the Galaxy Master's presence.

Just as the Xuanyuan Supreme and the other eight supremes' expressions were filled with elation, a figure emerged not far away.

It was Lin Yuan.

"Galaxy Master."

Xia Qin, the supreme being, looked toward Lin Yuan. At this moment, he could not feel any aura, as if there was simply no one before him, which showed how much Lin Yuan surpassed him in strength and realm.

"Galaxy Master, have you stepped into the Twelfth Layer?"

Xuanyuan Supreme also looked at Lin Yuan. Even though he was quite certain in his heart, he could not help but ask again.

Lin Yuan's face remained calm as he smiled and said, "The light boat has crossed the heavy mountains."
